<parameter name="say">Jack, I've got the start laid, but it only knocks over about two right now, so the head isn't hooked up yet. I'm looking at the nose and start area to see where it breaks.</parameter>
<parameter name="to">everyone</parameter>
<parameter name="point">[8.5, 7.5]</parameter>
<parameter name="eagerness">5</parameter>
<parameter name="pad">put_down</parameter>
<parameter name="do">inspect</parameter>
<parameter name="area">[3, 5, 11, 12]</parameter>
<parameter name="notes">Fish nose LEFT, V tail RIGHT. Start laid (8.5,7.5) facing down, only knocks ~2: not connected to top line (Jack, starts ~7,7.2) or belly. Nose bend (stroke 5, belly end ~(4,10) up to top line ~(7,7)) not built, gap there. Inspecting head area, then fix start link and bend. Eye only if time allows.</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
</invoke>
